about: Case boundary laws of the compiler-independent stream.

mutants.name: case-reseeds-stream
mutants.rule: Case boundaries do not change the draw sequence.

mutants.name: case-retains-world
mutants.rule: A builder's value is shared within one case, never across cases.

mutants.name: l10b-integer-no-narrowing
mutants.origin: wf10/L10b round 1 (moved from the lower ledger with the stream, wf10/l7-eval/EV4)
mutants.rule: Record magnitude after narrowing, so a smaller integer width shrinks by value rather than wrapping.

mutants.name: c5-near-returns-source
mutants.from:
if !Identical(v, src) && admits(v) {
			return v, true, true
mutants.to:
if !Identical(v, src) && admits(v) {
			return src, true, false
mutants.rule: The near-variant search returns the distinct equal value it finds, not the source itself (else Unfolded's EqualKeysHashEqual passes).

mutants.name: c5-near-zero-sign-ignored
mutants.rule: Identity reads a float's bits: 0.0 and -0.0 are == yet distinct, the pair hash must agree on (mutant 6's reach).

mutants.name: c5-near-identity-distinct
mutants.rule: A search that finds no distinct admitted variant reports the source as not distinct, so a run with none is a skip, never ok.
